They crave everything I represent, every promise my existence holds, and won't rest until they unlock my true potential. They might control my destiny, but will they ever own my heart? I'm going to help them reclaim their lost glory. This mortal? She's stronger than she looks. Den of Shadows is the spicy first installment of The Divine Harem Duet. This book is a reverse harem that may question religious beliefs as part of a fantasy story and ends on a cliffhanger. If this might offend you, please don't read it. Also, there is Insta-lust, so it might not be the book for you if you're not a fan.

title: Shadows Entwined
author: Eve Newton
description: Just when I thought things couldn't get more complicated at MistHallow Academy, my past and present collide in the worst way possible. My sire, the vampire who ruined my life but at the same time, gave me everything, has joined forces with the very Order who is trying to wipe me out. Their target is not just me, but the entire academy - my home, my haven, my friends, my loves. I'm still trying to balance my relationships with Caine, Thorne, and Flint. Each of them holds a piece of my heart, and now I realise they also hold the key to our survival. The Order of the Shadows Descent are closing in, and we're running out of options. With MistHallow under siege and the supernatural world on the brink of exposure, I'm forced to make impossible choices. Do I sacrifice the last of my humanity to save those I love? As the final battle looms, I'll have to trust in the strength of our love and the power of our unity. It all comes down to this. One night. One choice. One eternal bond. Welcome to the heart-pounding conclusion of the Shadows Descent Trilogy. This is a dark paranormal romance book 3 out of 3 in a brand new reverse harem romance by USA Today Bestselling Author, Eve Newton. Set in England and written in British English, you will come across TWs so please see inside for details.

title: Freeing Their Heart
author: Mira Stanley
description: In a botched attempt to take Cora for themselves, a rival settlement has taken Jud. Now, Cora and the remaining six men of Eagle Peak must leave their home and fight to get their leader back. In the post-virus world, not all fights are won with fists and guns. For better or worse, supernatural Gifts change the battlefield. To win the fight to come, Cora and her men must strengthen their Gifts, and the best way to do that is to explore their love for each other. While Cora and her men deepen their bond, they make new friends and run headlong into a war they can't afford to lose. Because the winner of this war will set the landscape for post-virus humankind. Will humanity's path follow the will of the Working, or will evil shroud the world in darkness? Warning: A woman with an abusive past finds her happy-ever-after with seven obsessed, over-the-top alpha males in a post-apocalyptic world. If you're looking for a reverse harem story bursting with eroticism against a backdrop just bleak enough to keep the tension going, this story is for you. Triggers: Past sexual assault, daddy-talk, copious use of pet names.

title: Prize
author: L V Lane
description: Publisher's note: Prize finishes on an HFN. There will be more adventures for Priya in book 3, Taken.I am prey. Prey that our dreaded enemy, the Blighten, search for. And I am a prize that noble lords vie for. I don't want to become a lord's prize anymore than I want to become the Blighten's prey. One would be a swift death. And one would be slow. That I must marry soon is not a decision for today, though, but a decision for tomorrow. Only tomorrow's choices never come. For tonight brings outlaws who remind me that I am prey.

title: Bound by Knots
author: Eden Blackwell
description: BOUND BY KNOTS: An Omegaverse Reverse Harem with Knotting Romance (Knotted Fate Series - Book 2) They claimed my heart. Now they'll claim my body. I fought them. I swore I would never surrender to alphas like them. But Kieran, Ronan, and Dante have shattered every wall I built, leaving me vulnerable... craving. Now, war is on the horizon, and our bond is the only thing standing between us and total destruction. But some wounds don't heal with time. Some battles are fought in the dark-where trust is a weapon and love is the ultimate weakness. They tell me I am theirs. That I belong to them in every way that matters. But an omega like me was never meant to be tamed. And if they think they can break me, they have no idea what's coming.

title: Earth Myth An Isekai Fantasy
author: Terence Park
description: Alan Bates is single, seldom in employment (or training), behind on his bills and addicted to online games; in particular Earth Myth. In Earth Myth, players participate in a fantasy recreation of epochal events in Earth history. Alan has just started a temporary job when, late one night, he's woken by a call; a girl claiming to be an NPC (non-playable character) from Earth Myth. Sivitya is a door witch. She's been hired to defend the house of Akalito, a level seven magister, from the dangers of the forest of Eald Widu. Unexpectedly she materialises in the real world with the message: House Batezz is in danger, and turns Alan Bates' world upside down. Alan Bates suspects this is a prank while Sivitya must work out if Alan Bates really is Akalito. Together they must figure out what is real, what can be done and what they mean to each other. Ultimately they must face a challenge beyond them and somehow survive.

title: A Fantasy Lazy Life T12
author: Tsunehiko Watanabe, Jyuu Ayakura
description: Pour préparer l'accouchement de la reine Aura et la venue au monde de leur deuxième enfant, Zenshirô part à la recherche d'un guérisseur. Mais lors d'une audience publique, Bruno, le roi de Charoy, annonce qu'il compte abdiquer son trône. Zenshirô se retrouve alors malgré lui impliqué dans les problèmes de succession d'un pays qui n'est pas le sien, sans parler des charmantes et mystérieuses jeunes femmes qui lui tournent autour... Qui succédera à Bruno et reprendra le trône de Charoy ?!

title: La Princesa Prometida
author: William Goldman
description: William Goldman's beloved story of Buttercup, Westley, and their fellow adventurers. This tale of true love, high adventure, pirates, princesses, giants, miracles, fencing, and a frightening assortment of wild beasts was unforgettably depicted in the 1987 film directed by Rob Reiner and starring Fred Savage, Robin Wright, and others. But, rich in character and satire, the novel boasts even more layers of ingenious storytelling. Set in 1941 and framed cleverly as an "abridged" retelling of a centuries-old tale set in the fabled country of Florin, home to "Beasts of all natures and descriptions. Pain. Death. Brave men. Coward men. Strongest men. Chases. Escapes. Lies. Truths. Passions." William Goldman's modern fantasy classic is an exceptional story about quests--for riches, revenge, power, and, of course, true love--that's thrilling and timeless for readers of all ages.

title: Sapiens. Una historia gráfica 1 - El nacimiento de la humanidad
author: Yuval Noah Harari, David Vandermeulen, Daniel Casanave
description: El primer volumen de la adaptación gráfica del fenómeno editorial de la no ficción, Sapiens. De animales a dioses de Yuval Noah Harari, bestseller internacional con más de veintiún millones de ejemplares vendidos, número 1 en la lista de The New York Times , recomendado por Barack Obama, Bill Gates y Mark Zuckerberg y repleto de magnificas ilustraciones. Conciso, ameno y divertido, un libro que fascinará a todo tipo de lectores. En un mundo inundado de información irrelevante, la claridad es poder. ¿Podemos aspirar a una visión panorámica de la especie humanasin caer en la espiral infinitade los pequeños detalles? Si damos un paso atrás y la observamos con gran angular, sí. Sapiens. Una historia gráfica es el brillante y provocador relato de cómo un simio insignificante consiguió imponerse en la lucha por la supervivencia y fue capaz de dominar el planeta Tierra, dividir el átomo, llegar a la Luna y manipular el código genético. En su primer libro, Sapiens. De animales a dioses, Yuval Noah Harari -considerado uno de los intelectuales más influyentes del mundo-narró de forma extraordinaria la compleja trama de la historia de la raza humana. Sapiens. El nacimiento de la humanidad constituye el primer volumen de la adaptación gráfica de un bestseller internacional que ha sido traducido a sesenta y cinco idiomas y lleva más de veintiún millones de ejemplares vendidos en todo el mundo. Con Harari como guía, te invitamos a dar un paseo por el lado más salvaje de nuestra evolución como especie en un recorrido repleto de humor, ingenio y personajes inolvidables como Bill el Troglodita, la Doctora Ficción o la detective López. Gracias a sus maravillosas ilustraciones y la forma de Harari de aproximarse a nuestro pasado, esta novela gráfica pretende entretener a nuevos lectores y contribuir a explorar las formas en que la biología y la historia nos han definido y han mejorado nuestra comprensión de lo que significa ser «humano». Sapiens: una historia gráfica ha sido incluida en el top 10 de las listas de más vendidos de The New York Times, The Whasington Post y LA Times. Nominada al prestigioso premio del festival de Angoulême. Sobre Sapiens. De animales a dioses se ha dicho... «Aborda las cuestiones más importantes de la historia y del mundo modernos, y además está escrito con un estilo vívido e inolvidable.» Jared Diamond, premio Pulitzer y autor de Armas, gérmenes y acero «Yuval Noah Harari es uno de mis escritores preferidos [...] La forma en la que cuenta nuestra historia te dejará completamente boquiabierto.» Natalie Portman «Interesante y provocador. Este libro nos da cierta perspectiva del poco tiempo que llevamos en la Tierra, de la corta vida de la ciencia y la agricultura, y de por qué no debemos dar nada por sentado.» Barack Obama «Recomendaría este libro a cualquier persona interesada en una historia de la humanidad a la vez entretenida y desafiante [...] No se puede dejar de leer.» Bill Gates «Un libro que invita a la reflexión.» Mark Zuckerberg «Por fin alguien ha escrito un libro como este.» Sebastian Junger

title: Slow Life In Another World (I Wish!) (Manga) Vol. 1
author: Shige
description: One salaryman is in for quite a surprise when his isekai fantasy becomes his all-too-real life! Itsuki Shimomiya, exhausted office worker, has hit the jackpot…right? Reborn in a fantastical world, Itsuki finds himself with a magical skill that generates fat stacks of cash once a day. It should let him finally relax without having to bother with your usual fantasy fuss of slaying monsters, but otherworldly cost of living is higher than you’d think. With his wit and otherworldly knowledge, can Itsuki finally create a relaxing life for himself?

title: Isekai Monster
author: Akos Esthoth
description: In a typical fantasy world overrun with heroes and demons. A not so typical princess waits for fate to guild her directionless life. Then one day her fate is shifted with the summoning of a new hero. The princess herself calls this hero with her desire for change. However, this hero is unlike any other before him this hero is by no means normal. This hero can be more easily be described as a monster. By almost every possible measure he is a monster in the guise of a hero. How will this typical fantasy world and not so typical princess change with the arrival of this new kind of hero? For even, if he is by all rights a monster he is trying his hardest to be the hero that she wants him to be.

title: Reborn As a Fire Mage
author: Austin Beck
description: Can a firefighter learn to embrace the very thing he has tried to kill his entire career? Mason Magrath is an alpha male, heroic firefighter, and an incredible lover. That was until he falls down an elevator shaft of a burning skyscraper in an attempt to save the life of a child. This is the end for our hero... right? Well, not exactly... Mason is snatched from the afterlife by a god that wants to use him as a pawn in a game of life and death on the world of Lelara. Monstrous fiends roam the planet with a ravenous taste for flesh. Instead of fighting fires, Mason must use his new powers as Fire Mage to build a refuge to protect himself from the monstrous horde. He can't do all this alone, though. Rescuing people comes naturally to him, and when a pair of catgirl sisters needs him, he fights off Hell itself to save them. With the help of Lola and Piper, he'll use all the heat at his disposal as a powerful weapon against the terrifying monsters that reside on Lelara. Fans of "The Walking Dead" and "The Lord of the Rings" will love this action-packed light novel. Like firefighting, it'll get your heart pumping, with plenty of profanity, graphic violence, detailed intimacy, and unconventional relationships. The heat level of this book is hotter than fire!

title: Goblin Elves
author: JACK. BLUE
description: Goblin Elves: An Isekai Fantasy When Alex is unexpectedly whisked away from his world and dropped into the enchanting realm of Elnora, he finds himself in the heart of a prophecy within a world dominated by the mysterious goblin elves. His arrival, a result of a summoning ritual gone awry, marks the beginning of a journey filled with magic, danger, and an unforeseen connection with Lyris, a native whose fate is deeply intertwined with his own.

title: Isekai General
author: Marcus Sloss, Alex Tanway
description: Assemble, Conquer, Dominate. After some rough tours during the Drone Wars, Reggie finds himself visiting a best friend's mausoleum. As he's paying his respects, a visitor from a land of myth and magic offers him a chance to bring Gary back - but there's a catch. He'll become a named character who's capable of magic, destined to lead a small army, and tasked with the unimaginable feat of winning a losing war one fight at a time. The battles will be just as savage as the realm is, but if he commands his troops as a cunning and capable general, he'll unlock the unimaginable.

title: La isla del fin del mundo
author: Javier F. Campos
description: A short novel inspired by magic realism, about a self-sufficient town of a thousand inhabitants on a remote island who are mysteriously supplied every six months by a navy ship with hundreds of boxes of magazines, books, and newspapers. The heart of this nameless land is the librarian because the library gives life to the island and is the center of knowledge, the inhabitants all seemingly children of literature.

title: A Man's Word 2
author: STOHAM. BAGINBOTT, Marcus Sloss
description: Keep my Promises, Avert the Impending Doom, Save the Damsels! Okay, so arriving in a strange new land wasn't the worst thing to happen. That doesn't mean I get to sit around and do nothing. While I'd kill to be able to relax one day, that's not what fate has in store for me as I protect my family and keep my word.

title: A Farming Fantasy Isekai
description: Tadala has always had a tought time of things for as long as she can remember. From the incident in her youth to the looks that everyone around her gives. Tadala thinks if she could just disappear from the world and start fresh where nobody knows her or her family, she could be happy. One fated night, a run-in with those she thought she could trust changes her life forever.

title: Aethermarked
author: Nolan Locke, Damien Hanson
description: Friendless, broken by grief, tired of the real world, Jin-ee represents the perfect candidate for the new on-site 24/7 fully immersive gaming sensation, Aethermarked. Of course becoming Phallania Trevellian is more than she ever dreamed, and more than she bargained for. From the moment she submerges into a vat of conductive nanogel and chooses her first spell, she's captivated at the reality and wonder of the wide magical world around her, a new life so different from what she'd had in the real world. That is, until the game refuses to let her out. Jin-ee has no choice but to become her character, and trust that the people behind the game are honestly trying to free her, rather than use her as a televised marketing sensation to drive up sales. Things take a turn down a dark path when Phallania faces down eldritch horrors, and battles fiends for her very survival. It is only then she realizes that what she thought was a game may be more than she bargained for. Warning: Things get dark at times. There might sometimes be content that you find traumatic. This LitRPG Isekai contains scenes of torture and minor fade-to-black sexual content.

title: A Man's Word 3
author: STOHAM. BAGINBOTT, Marcus Sloss
description: Keep my Promises, Free the Goddess, Make a Home! With possible wars on the horizon, I've got to find a spot for my family, secure my borders, and prepare to keep them safe. Oh, and I need to free a goddess, because I said I would. Maybe, just maybe, if everything goes right, I'll be able to kick back and enjoy the rewards of keeping my word.

title: Witch Girl Study Group 3
author: Milo Storm
description: Tensions rise in Aether Academy as cultists from the Knights of Eradication gather at its border. Angry protests threaten to turn into something much more dangerous, and an outside influence seems to fuel their confidence. Meanwhile, a mysterious patron approaches Jake with a job for the Shadows. All he needs to do is help take down one of the most powerful mages in the world. Jake needs to balance his priorities. He searches for a way to break his ties to the dark God Vethris, develops his own fighting style as he chooses his next round of classes, and adds a new member to the study group. But his lies are starting to catch up to him. When it all comes to a head, will his harem still have his back? Or will they only see the Shadows Jake has been hiding in all along... **Witch Girl Study Group 3 is an 18+ isekai fantasy harem story with slice of life elements and explicit adult situations**

title: Witch Girl Study Group 5
author: Milo Storm
description: Jake is more powerful than ever, but can he save Aether, his mother, and his estranged brother at the same time? The man who started everything, Jake's father, is under cover as a visiting scholar. He threatens Jake's mother and works in the shadows to broker a deal that would make him Headmaster of his own school, but what is he really after? Meanwhile, a beautiful old friend is awaiting exorcism in Aether's dungeons. Breaking her out is one thing. Fixing her reputation is another. Jake will need to sacrifice something he holds dear in order to make things right. If he wants to keep his mother safe, Jake will need to find a way home. But will he stay there, or live in Aether forever? **Witch Girl Study Group 5 is the final volume in an isekai fantasy harem series with slice of life elements and explicit adult situations**

title: My Isekai Life
author: Shinkoshoto
genres: Fantasy comic books, strips, etc - isekai fantasy

title: Isekai Tensei: Recruited to Another World Volume 1
author: Kenichi
description: After waking up at his own funeral, Tenma Otori gets a second chance at life when a god from another world presents him with an enticing offer: if Tenma agrees to be reincarnated in order to save their dying world, the gods will bestow cheat abilities upon him. Tenma accepts, and is reborn in a lush fantasy world filled with demi-humans, magic spells and items, monsters, mysterious forests, and more! As he grows, more of his gods-given powers and abilitiesâincluding his unique power to befriend adorable monsters like slimes and baby wolvesâare revealed to his adoptive parents, two former master adventurers, and his grandfather, a famous wizard. But one fateful day, three mysterious strangers shatter the tranquility of Tenmaâs village by trying to kidnap him, and thatâs where Tenmaâs adventure really begins...

title: Pandemonia Chronicles
author: Carey Martell
description: This special edition re-release of the original story features 32 full page manga-style illustrations as an English language light novel. Join a daring young man on his adventure in an exciting fantasy world inspired by popular role playing video games and Japanese Isekai / LitRPG light novels! An encounter with a strange medallion leaves sixteen year old Gestalt possessed by the spirit of an ancient Demon King, making him a key player in a war between the Demon King and the Goddess of Life. Unfortunately, the Demon King wants to destroy the world and the Goddess wants to enslave everyone in it! With the aid of a talking teddy bear, a grumpy demon dog and a unicorn princess who wants to marry him, Gestalt embarks on a journey to stop the Goddess' sinister plot and find a way to get rid of the Demon King - yet, he must also rely on the dark power of the Demon King in order to stand a chance against the powerful minions of the Goddess. Can Gestalt resist against the corrupting temptations of the Demon King and save the world, rather than destroy it? Is it even possible for a mere human to stand up against the power of a Goddess? If you enjoy humorous tales of action and adventure in light novel fantasy worlds for teen and young adults, you're sure to enjoy Pandemonia Chronicles: DAWN Special Edition! This is an excellent fantasy book for kids. If you want to read fantasy books for teens, fantasy books with romance (such as between a unicorn princess and a human boy) and new fantasy books, Pandemonia Chronicles is a good book for you. This is also a fantasy book about magic, magicians, demons, a unicorn princess and other magical creatures.

title: Slow Life In Another World (I Wish!) (Manga) Vol. 1
author: Shige, Nagayori
description: Itsuki Shimomiya, exhausted office worker, has hit the jackpot...right? Reborn in a fantastical world, Itsuki finds himself with a magical skill that generates fat stacks of cash once a day. It should let him finally relax without having to bother with your usual fantasy fuss of slaying monsters, but otherworldly cost of living is higher than you'd think. With his wit and otherworldly knowledge, can Itsuki finally create a relaxing life for himself?

title: Gacha Girls Corps Vol. 1 (manga)
author: chinkururi
description: UR-GUARANTEED—TO HAVE THE ADVENTURE OF A LIFETIME! Ready for an adventure that's out of this world? We've gacha covered. Norl's a cutting-edge cutie with a cutting edge who's a cut above the rest. Heihachi's just your average mobile game addict with a whale-sized hole in his wallet. But one day, he pulls an item that pulls him into another world, spinning his life around with a spin of the gacha. Attacked by monsters, and left without options, Heihachi does what he knows best—roll gacha! To his surprise, he watches his unit materialize before his eyes. Heihachi's used to seeing cute girls pop up on his phone, but he's never seen one pop out of his phone! Join him on his quest to collect OP UR QTs! (That's Overpowered Ultra Rare Cuties.)

title: Our Not-So-Lonely Planet Travel Guide, Volume 3
author: Mone Sorai
description: Super serious Asahi Suzumura and laidback, easygoing Mitsuki Sayama continue their trip around the world together with the goal in mind of getting married at the end. This time, they're meeting old friends in England, observing the natural beauty of Scotland, visiting famous churches in Spain, and traversing the Sahara atop camels. Despite his initial reservations, could all of these beautiful experiences from traveling together and meeting kind, welcoming strangers be the catalyst Asahi needs to finally be openly proud of his relationship with Mitsuki?

title: Ossan Idol!, Volume 6
author: Mochida
description: MiYoShi lands a new gig on a popular TV travel show and their costars are... TENKA?! The two idol groups fight their way through a “terrifying” test of courage while staff behind the scenes have to work hard to do their jobs without getting distracted when faced with Miroku's princely charm. As if that wasn't difficult enough, Shiju faces off with an old flame and MiYoShi relive their high school days during an unexpected gig. The life of an ossan idol is never easy!

title: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World: Volume 2
author: Tamamaru
description: Eizo Tanya is now living a quiet life as a blacksmith in another world. Well, maybe not so quiet... Tales of his cheat smithing abilities and overpowered blades have started to spread. Alongside his companions, Eizo tries to earn a modest living while avoiding political intrigue. However, intrigue finds him anyway when he saves Diana, the daughter of a comital family. With the nobility embroiled in conflict about the line of succession and the fate of a family heirloom, the safest place for Diana turns out to be with Eizo. As his family keeps growing, the quiet life becomes even more rare. Speaking of rare, Eizo’s next commission involves working with a prized fantasy metal—mithril! When an elven village requests that he repair their treasure, a mithril sword, Eizo is excited to take on the challenge. But will this blade be too much for a human blacksmith to handle? Eizo puts his cheats to the test, repairing both swords and societal conflicts, all in pursuit of his dream life!

title: Hollow Regalia, Vol. 5 (light novel)
author: Gakuto Mikumo
description: After their fierce battle in Nagoya and their horrible discoveries about the Japanese populace-turned-Moujuu, Yahiro and Iroha are headed to Kyoto for answers. There, they plan to meet the mysterious Karura Myoujiin who called for them. What they didn’t expect to find is Marquis Eusebius Berith and the Galerie’s European HQ soldiers. Though the marquis heaps praise and accolades on Giuli and Rosé, it’s not that easy to pull the wool over the twins’ eyes! They know he’s up to something, and they’ve got some schemes of their own in motion. With Karura’s help, hopefully they can learn the truth about the dragon mediums and the world—but what they discover may not lead to the salvation they wished for...

title: The Trials and Tribulations of My Next Life as a Noblewoman: Volume 2
author: Kamihara
description: Having settled into her new life as Margravine of Conrad, Karen’s world is turned upside down when a foreign nation launches an attack on the domain. With the vast majority of Conrad’s residents dead, leaving the nation of Falkrum reeling at this turn of events, Karen’s position is suddenly very precarious. How will she navigate the military intrigue, the mysterious Reinald, and those scheming to take what’s left of Conrad as their own?

title: This Is Screwed Up, but I Was Reincarnated as a GIRL in Another World! (Manga) Vol. 8
author: Ashi, Keyaki Uchiuchi
description: Ren, Lillie, and Arisa have successfully completed their gathering quest ! Now Ren turns her attention to becoming an artisan swordsmith, and savors every moment in every possible way. After she charms the stubborn head of the forge, the clanging of metal on metal never ceases, and she quickly masters the creation of magical weapons. However, an unexpected reunion with someone is lurking in the shadows, ready to present itself the moment Ren least expects it! Will the conversation be pointed, or will it be the swords?

title: In Another World, My Sister Stole My Name, Vol. 3
author: Kotoko
description: As the kingdom’s second saint, Ichika has her hands full—with her day-to-day duties, her relationships with two princes, and her elder sister, who has grown far more distant than she remembers. So of course, the king couldn’t have picked a better time to send them all on a diplomatic visit to the neighboring country! As Ichika scrambles to study up on magic before the trip, she encounters a young girl named Levie who offers to teach her. But there seems to be more to this mysterious child than meets the eye...Just who is Ichika’s strange new tutor? And what other secrets will she uncover as she delves deeper into the world of the mirror?

title: Sorcière d'un autre monde T04
author: Tail Yuzuhara, Sora
description: Convoquée par Isaac, l'illustre chef suprême considéré comme le plus puissant du continent, Sena accepte de se rendre à Fonduna, empire voisin de Beclair. Accompagnée de Keith, elle y rencontre Gedeon, le Roidragon du Feu, contraint par une chaîne magique. Excédée par les outrages et la tyrannie d'Isaac, Sena finit par tenir tête au despote en libérant un pouvoir encore insoupçonné, avant de se retrouver à son tour prisonnière...

title: Le Huitième fils T10
author: Hiroki Kusumoto, Y.A, Fuzichoco
description: Après la purification des morts-vivants, la compagnie de Well reçoit l'aide du troisième fils, Paul. Il leur offre des gardes du corps, parmi lesquels se trouve une jeune fille à la force surhumaine. Elle est l'arme secrète du maréchal Edgar mais aussi... la nouvelle aspirante concubine de Well !

title: L'EXTRAordinaire Apothicaire T08
author: Yuka Tachibana, Fujiazuki, Yasuyuki Syuri
description: Sei, une jeune employée de bureau, ne vit que pour son travail. Sa vie va basculer lorsqu'elle se retrouve, malgré elle, invoquée dans un autre monde. Aira et le commandant des mages rejoignent l'équipe partie en expédition au domaine de Krausner. Pour éliminer les slimes, Sei et ses compagnons réorganisent les troupes et se rendent de nouveau dans la forêt. Après quoi, au fond des bois...

title: Cheat Skill Level Up T06
author: Miku, Kazuomi Minatogawa, Rein KUWASHIMA
description: Yuyâ est un garçon légèrement enrobé qui a toujours été victime de harcèlement. Il ne trouve de répit que dans les moments de solitude, dans la maison que son grand-père lui a léguée. Un jour, en faisant du tri, il tombe accidentellement sur une pièce secrète dans laquelle se trouve une mystérieuse porte et des objets médiévaux qu'il n'avait jamais vus. Une fois franchie, cette porte l'emmène dans un monde de fantasy.

title: Sorcière d'un autre monde T06
author: Tail Yuzuhara, Sora
description: Suite au complot mené par Michelo l'Usurpateur, le déchaînement des dragons aggrave le conflit. Pendant ce temps, les partisans d'Eduardo se démènent tristement sous les rugissements des créatures aliénées. "Je suis à tes côtés ! Tu peux le faire !" Les encouragements de Keith suffiront-ils à inspirer à Sena un sortilège assez puissant pour renverser la situation ?

title: Cheat Skill Level Up T04
author: Miku, Kazuomi Minatogawa, Rein KUWASHIMA
description: Parce que je suis moche. C'est pour cette unique raison que Yûya Tenjô subit de violentes brimades depuis sa plus tendre enfance. Sa vie va pourtant basculer le jour où il découvre l'existence d'un mystérieux portail. Tandis qu'il explore la Tanière des démons , notre héros tombe sur une étrange grotte... Il y trouve alors le journal du sage légendaire, grâce à qui il a obtenu diverses compétences. Bien qu'il possède déjà de nombreuses aptitudes extraordinaires, Yûya atteindra un niveau encore plus élevé grâce à cette découverte magique, de sorte que ses pouvoirs rivaliseront presque avec ceux de Dame Nature...

title: Mynoghra, Annonciateur de l'apocalypse T04
author: Yasaiko Midorihana, Fehu Kazuno
description: Takuto Ira, roi de la nation maléfique de Mynoghra, et son bras droit Atô découvrent que les monstres qui attaquent Dragontann viennent d’un jeu différent d’Eternal Nations. Plongés dans l’inconnu, ils doivent donc faire face à des ennemis venus d’un jeu de rôle et obéissant à des systèmes différents des leurs. Mais alors qu’Atô combat l’un de leurs généraux, un autre se lance à l’assaut du territoire maudit ! Il est temps pour Isla, deuxième héroïne de Mynoghra, de passer à l’action !

title: Mon destin... entre les mains des femmes T01
author: Yomu Mishima, Jun Shiosato
description: Léon est réincarné dans un monde du type jeu vidéo féminin. Un monde contrôlé par des femmes et dans lequel les hommes n'ont aucun pouvoir, aucune possession et dépendent de leur mère ou de leur femme. Seule exception, un groupe de beaux jeunes hommes dirigés par le prince. Oprimé et désespéré, Léon va alors utiliser les connaissances de son ancienne vie pour se rebeller contre ce système.

title: Sorcière d'un autre monde T02
author: Tail Yuzuhara, Sora
description: Après une longue période de solitude, Sena redécouvre le monde extérieur sous la houlette de Keith, le prince incognito. Mais alors qu'elle cherche à en apprendre plus sur son étrange magie dans la bibliothèque de la cité royale, elle est surprise par l'attaque d'un dragon enragé. Ressentant plus de nostalgie que de crainte, elle s'éveille à son pouvoir d'invocatrice et libère l'aliéné de ses souffrancesgrâce à son sort Extinction ! ...

title: Sorcière d'un autre monde T03
author: Tail Yuzuhara, Sora
description: Sena et Keith regagnent Beclair après avoir apaisé Rishkall, le Roi-dragon du Vent. Tout le royaume est en liesse suite au retour triomphal de l'invocatrice, mais une missive de l'empire de Fonduna vient brusquement mettre fin aux festivités. L'empereur Isaac, voisin belliqueux, menace de lancer une offensive contre le territoire de Beclair si Sena ne répond pas positivement à sa convocation.

title: Mon destin... entre les mains des femmes T06
author: Yomu Mishima, Jun Shiosato, Monda
description: Depuis le dernier combat, Léon remet en cause son rôle dans le monde. Il prend alors une grande décision : garder ses distances avec Marie et Angélica. Dès lors, leurs relations se dégradent et même l'ambiance festif du « voyage scolaire » n'arrange rien. Il n'y a pas que leur amitié qui est péril, leur tranquillité également ! Un nouveau danger guette et leur voyage pourrait mener tout droit à une guerre entre royaumes...

title: Le Huitième fils T05
author: Hiroki Kusumoto
description: Le séjour de nos amis dans la capitale suit son cours. Comme toujours, Wendelin se démène avec les contraintes que son statut lui impose. Pendant ce temps, lui et ses amis poursuivent leur apprentissage. Bientôt, ils auront tous atteint l'âge requis pour former leur propre compagnie d'aventuriers...

title: Mynoghra, Annonciateur de l'apocalypse T02
author: Yasaiko Midorihana, Fehu Kazuno
description: Devenu roi de Mynoghra, Takuto Ira s'est pleinement lancé dans le développement de sa nation, épaulé par Atô, son fidèle bras droit, et d'une population d'elfes noirs qui lui valent une fidélité sans faille. Mais alors qu'il semblait sereinement progresser vers la fondation d'un royaume pacifique, l'existence de Mynoghra est soudainement détectée par ses pays voisins... Une découverte qui va changer la face du monde entier !

title: Le Huitième fils T06
author: Hiroki Kusumoto
description: Alors que Wendelin et ses amis exploraient gaiement un site archéologique, les jeunes aventuriers tombent dans un piège. Perdus dans les souterrains des vestiges, ils sont désormais contraints à une longue remontée pour retrouver la surface. C'était sans compter sur l'armée de golems qui leur barre le passage...

title: Mon destin... entre les mains des femmes T04
author: Yomu Mishima, Jun Shiosato
description: Officiellement, la reine se rend aux festivités de l'académie pour " protester contre les actions de Léon à l'égard de son fils ", mais elle semble plutôt chercher les réelles intentions de notre héros. Exténué par cette entrevue avec la reine et d'autres altercations, Léon doit maintenant s'occuper d'une dénommée Carla. Ayant eu vent des exploits de Léon, cette dernière implore son aide pour vaincre les pirates de l'air saccageant son territoire... Au diable, les beaux gosses ! Léon ne laissera personne lui dicter ses choix. Des combats grandioses, une rébellion grandissante... Retrouvez notre héros hors du commun dans ce quatrième tome !

title: Le Huitième fils T13
author: Hiroki Kusumoto, Y .A, Fuzichoco
description: Défié par Katharina, la noble déchue, à un affrontement pour déterminer qui est le meilleur aventurier, Well décide d'accepter. Il espère s'en débarrasser en la battant une bonne fois pour toutes, mais cette farouche demoiselle, prête à tout pour restaurer l'honneur de sa famille, n'abandonnera pas si facilement...

title: Cheat Skill Level Up T05
author: Miku, Kazuomi Minatogawa, Rein KUWASHIMA
description: "Parce que je suis moche." C'est pour cette unique raison que Yûya Tenjô subit de violentes brimades depuis sa plus tendre enfance. Sa vie va pourtant basculer le jour où il découvre l'existence d'un mystérieux portail. Une fois l'entraînement de Luna terminé, Yûya Tenjô retourne dans le monde réel afin de participer à la sortie scolaire organisée avec sa classe de l'académie Ôsei. Cuisine, cueillette, pêche... Cette escapade, ayant pour but de développer diverses aptitudes chez les élèves, n'est qu'une formalité pour Yûya et ses compétences abusées... Même en pleine nature, notre jeune héros continue d'en mettre plein la vue à ses camarades avec ses nombreux talents !

title: Le Huitième fils T09
author: Hiroki Kusumoto
description: Après la bataille rudement menée, Well et ses amis retrouvent Klaus qui les attend. Ce dernier leur révèle ses soupçons envers le seigneur Baumeister. Cette discussion incite Well à prendre une décision cruciale...

title: Le Huitième fils T11
author: Hiroki Kusumoto, Y.A, Fuzichoco
description: Kurt est sur le point d'exploser suite à son conflit avec Well. C'est alors qu'un messager du baron Ruckner apparaît et lui remet une mystérieuse boîte renfermant un «outil pour éliminer Well». Désespéré, Kurt ne peut résister à cette opportunité. De sérieux ennuis se profilent pour Well !

title: Cheat Skill Level Up T02
author: Miku, Kazuomi Minatogawa, Rein KUWASHIMA
description: Tenjo est un garçon légèrement enrobé qui a toujours été victime de harcèlement. Il ne trouve de répit que dans les moments de solitude, dans la maison que son grand-père lui a léguée. Un jour, en faisant du tri, il tombe accidentellement sur une pièce secrète dans laquelle se trouve une mystérieuse porte et des objets médiévaux qu'il n'avait jamais vus. Une fois franchie, cette porte l'emmène dans un monde de fantasy.

title: Mynoghra, Annonciateur de l'apocalypse T03
author: Yasaiko Midorihana, Fehu Kazuno
description: Takuto Ira, roi de la nation maléfique de Mynoghra, décide de s'allier à Faunkavenn, la nation multiraciale voisine, afin d'accroître sa population et de gagner accès à sa précieuse mine de " dracoveine ". Il doit désormais envoyer une expédition visiter la petite ville de Dragontann, où se trouve la mine en question. Après de nombreuses délibérations, il décide d'y mandater les jumelles, accompagnées de trois gardes du corps au comportement tout aussi étrange que leur apparence...

title: Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned into a Pig- Second Bite
author: Takuma Sakai
description: With the help of newfound comrades, our otaku protagonist makes a valiant return to the fantasy world of Mesteria—as a pig, of course! However, his most precious heroine, Jess, is missing. But that doesn’t matter because he didn’t come back to enjoy a fluffy fantasy life with Jess. He totally doesn’t miss the girl he fell head over heels for! He’s not s-whining or dis-grunt-led at all! There are also more pressing problems Mister Pig must deal with. Mesteria changed completely during his absence. The nation’s torn apart by a war between the royal court and the underground society, and the handsome huntsman Naut has become a revolutionary focused on liberating all Yethma. Our protagonist’s mission is to help Naut and save the poor Yethma of this world! Together with Ceres and a new pig companion, Sanon, Mister Pig sets out on a journey filled with twists and turns. Will he reunite with his sweet, angelic savior?

title: Mon destin... entre les mains des femmes T07
author: Yomu Mishima, Jun Shiosato, Monda
description: Après avoir neutralisé les monstres et mis déroute leur vaisseau, Léon parvient à récupérer Angie et à emprisonner Hertrude. Mais il est toujours encerclé par les ennemis, et la situation est critique... Quand la victoire semble enfin à portée de main, la principauté de Fanoss dévoile son plus fort combattant : Vandel, le Chevalier Noir. Angie a besoin d'aide ! Et que se passe-t-il entre Livia et Léon ? Les ennemis affluent de tous les côtés ! Léon sortira-t-il vainqueur de cette bataille ? Léon est résolu ! Pour le bien de Livia, il ramènera l'histoire sur la voie prévue ! Un nouveau volume plein de péripéties où la romance comme les combats ne cessent de monter en intensité ! Voici le tant attendu septième tome de cet isekai aux rôles inversés !

title: Cinema as a Worldbuilding Machine in the Digital Era
author: Alain Boillat
description: This essay examines the primacy of worldbuilding in the age of CGI, transmedia practices and "high concept" fiction by studying the principles that govern the creation of a multiverse in a wide range of film and TV productions. Emphasis is placed on Hollywood sci-fi movies and their on-screen representation of imaginary machines that mirror the film medium, following in the tradition of Philip K. Dick's writings and the cyberpunk culture. A typology of worlds is established, as well as a number of analytical tools for assessing the impact of the coexistence of two or more worlds on the narrative structure, the style (uses of color, editing practices), the generic affiliation (or hybridity), the seriality and the discourse produced by a given film (particularly in fictions linked to post-9/11 fantasies). Among the various titles examined, the reader is offered a detailed analysis of the Resident Evil film series, Total Recall and its remake, Dark City, the Matrix trilogy, Avatar, Source Code and other time-loop films, TRON and its sequel, Christopher Nolan's Tenet, and several TV shows – most notably HBO's Westworld, but also Sliders, Lost, Fringe and Counterpart.

title: Mynoghra, Annonciateur de l'Apocalypse T03
author: Fehu Kazuno
description: Alors que Takuto doit toujours s'occuper des évènements de Dragontann, un nouvel ennemi fait une apparition des plus inattendues ! Les armées du Roi Démon, que Takuto reconnaît comme venant d'un autre jeu, le forcent à entièrement revoir sa stratégie... Comment va-t-il affronter un adversaire dont les mécaniques sont totalement différentes des siennes ? Mahô Éditions est une maison d’édition indépendante de Mangas et de Light Novels. Encore peu connus en France, les Light Novels (ou LN) sont des romans dont le récit est ponctué d’illustrations-clés d’influence japonaise.

title: Cheat Skill Level Up T03
author: Miku, Kazuomi Minatogawa, Rein KUWASHIMA
description: Parce que je suis moche. C'est pour cette unique raison que Yûya Tenjô subit de violentes brimades depuis sa plus tendre enfance. Sa vie va pourtant basculer le jour où il découvre l'existence d'un mystérieux portail. Bien que la princesse Lexia l'ait demandé en mariage en plus de l'inviter à la cour du royaume d'Alseria, Yûya Tenjô doit retourner dans le monde réel pour intégrer l'académie Ôsei. Ses compétences extraordinaires lui permettent d'ailleurs d'exceller dans tous les domaines, que ce soit dans les études, le sport ou les activités parascolaires... Malgré lui, il devient petit à petit le héros de son école ! Même au sein de l'élite de son pays, Yûya continue d'écraser toute la concurrence !

title: Sorcière d'un autre monde T05
author: Tail Yuzuhara, Sora
description: Après avoir libéré Gedeon de sa chaîne magique, Sena apprend ce que cachaient réellement les provocations de l'empereur Isaac. Forte de cette nouvelle expérience sur les relations entre dragons et humains, elle s'apprête à regagner le royaume de Beclair en compagnie de Keith et de ses gardes... Quand soudain, une pluie battante se met à tomber, annonçant l'arrivée d'une nouvelle créature. C'est Shirïn, la Reine-dragonne de l'Eau, qui implore Sena... de l'éliminer ! Touchée de plein fouet par le chagrin de Shirïn et intriguée par son étrange requête, Sena décide de l'accompagner à Ciepla, un royaume entouré d'une mer opulente.

title: L'EXTRAordinaire Apothicaire T05
author: Yuka Tachibana, Fujiazuki, Yasuyuki Syuri
description: Sei, une jeune employée de bureau, ne vit que pour son travail. Sa vie va basculer lorsqu'elle se retrouve, malgré elle, invoquée dans un autre monde. Le mystérieux sort, lancé par Sei, crée une curieuse brume dorée qui se dépose sur les plantes médicinales du jardin. Les potions concoctées par la suite sont alors quatre fois plus effi caces ! Malgré plusieurs essais de ce " sort sacré ", Sei échoue à le lancer à nouveau. Alors qu'elle se trouve dans une impasse, une demande du palais pour une mission dans la forêt de l'Ouest vient bouleverser cette situation...

title: L'EXTRAordinaire Apothicaire T01
author: Yuka Tachibana, Fujiazuki, Yasuyuki Syuri
description: Sei, une accro au travail, se retrouve invoquée par erreur dans un autre monde lors d'un rituel qui a pour but d'invoquer une Sainte qui pourra éradiquer tous les démons. Après son arrivée, seule l'autre jeune fille invoquée en même temps est emmenée voir le Prince. Après avoir quitté le palais, Sei commence à travailler dans un laboratoire de recherches et découvre cette nouvelle vie.

title: Mynoghra, Annonciateur de l'apocalypse T01
author: Yasaiko Midorihana, Fehu Kazuno
description: Takuto Ira est le joueur n°1 d'Eternal Nations, un jeu de stratégie très populaire. Il meurt soudainement d'une maladie incurable, mais par le heureux hasard, il se réveille réincarné dans un univers semblable à celui de son jeu vidéo préféré. Face à lui, il découvre Atô, l'héroïne de la nation de Mynoghra avec laquelle il jouait à chaque partie. Ils décident de s'unir pour créer un nouveau royaume.

title: Weird Tales: 100 Years of Weird
author: Jonathan Maberry, various authors
description: Celebrating the 100th anniversary of the first issues of Weird Tales Magazine, 100 Years of Weird is a masterful compendium of new and classic stories, flash fiction, essays, and poems from the giants of speculative fiction, including R. L. Stine, Laurell K. Hamilton, Ray Bradbury, H. P. Lovecraft, Tennessee Williams, and Isaac Asimov. Marking a century of uniquely peculiar storytelling, each part of this anthology features a different genre, from Cosmic Horror, Sword and Sorcery, Space Opera, to the Truly Weird—things too strange to publish elsewhere, and the magazine’s raison d’etre. Landmark stories such as “The Call of Cthulhu,” “Worms of the Earth,” and “Legal Rites” stand beside original stories and insightful essays from today’s masters of speculative fiction. This visually stunning hardcover edition is a collector’s dream, illustrated throughout with classic full-color and black & white art from past issues of Weird Tales Magazine.

title: The Medial Afterlives of H.P. Lovecraft
author: Tim Lanzendörfer, Max José Dreysse Passos de Carvalho
description: Medial Afterlives of H.P. Lovecraft brings together essays on the theory and practice of adapting H.P. Lovecraft’s fiction and the Lovecraftian. It draws on recent adaptation theory as well as broader discourses around media affordances to give an overview over the presence of Lovecraft in contemporary media as well as the importance of contemporary media in shaping what we take Lovecraft’s legacy to be. Discussing a wide array of medial forms, from film and TV to comics, podcasts, and video and board games, and bringing together an international group of scholars, the volume analyzes individual instances of adaptation as well as the larger concern of what it is possible to learn about adaptation from the example of H.P. Lovecraft, and how we construct Lovecraft and the Lovecraftian today in adaptation. Medial Afterlives of H.P. Lovecraft is focused on an academic audience, but it will nonetheless hold interest for all readers interested in Lovecraft today.

title: Alien Invasion Comics
author: Cora Lennox, AI
description: Alien Invasion Comics explores how comic books have mirrored and shaped our understanding of extraterrestrial life. More than just escapist entertainment, these visual narratives reflect deep-seated anxieties and hopes about the unknown, offering cultural commentary on real-world issues. Did you know that early alien invasion comics often served as allegories for the Cold War, reflecting fears of foreign invasion and ideological conflict? Further, depictions of first contact scenarios frequently mirror real-world anxieties about cultural exchange and the potential for misunderstanding. The book progresses chronologically, tracing the evolution of alien tropes from the Golden Age of comics to contemporary works. It examines how social and political events have influenced these narratives, analyzing specific comic panels to uncover deeper meanings. By studying intergalactic warfare and alien encounters, the book reveals how these fictional stories provide insights into our own values and biases. This unique approach makes Alien Invasion Comics a valuable resource for those interested in understanding the intersection of comics, science fiction, and cultural studies.

title: Aspects of Science Fiction Studies: A Collection of Miscellaneous Articles on the Intersection of Posthumanism, Transhumanism, Anthropocene, and Post-Anthropocentrism in Some Select, Contemporary Novels
author: Dr. Indrajit Patra
description: The book intends to present a critique of some select, 21st Century, hard science fiction novels in order to explicate the various ways in which the elements of posthumanism, transhumanism, techno-singularity intersect and interact with other such ideas as monstrosity, animality, machinicity, post-anthropocentrism, and Anthropocene. The study divides its analysis into seven different chapters and attempts to present an elaborate study on various aspects of posthumanism, transhumanism, and singularity. The book despite being a collection of miscellaneous essays actually intends to show how a technologically mediated transhuman/posthuman culture will normally be defined by a total dissolution of binaries such as digital and real, animal and human, and machine and man. The book also wants to describe through its analysis of some select hard science fiction novels, that man-machine merger and creation of hyper-immersive virtual reality can function as two of the most effective agents for catalyzing a radically transformative, posthuman, post-scarcity, and techno-utopian culture. The analysis presented in the book is not totally oriented to the discussion of far-future implications of accelerated technological progress which is imperative for arriving at a transhuman or posthuman stage; rather, the book is equally concerned with the implications of rapid technological advancements in our present times, and so the study also posits that before ascending to the heights of posthuman status mankind has to cope with the good and bad aspects of the Anthropocene which is the next stage in our collective evolution and journey towards the trans-/posthuman state. The first chapter of this study attempts to bring to focus the phenomenon of a technologically-mediated dissolution of the binaries between man/animal, human/nonhuman, and subject/object which will be extremely important in the analysis of the emergence of a posthuman culture later in the study. Technological advancements can be seen here as either conducive towards creating a harmonious relationship between man and animal or through systematic denigration of the agency of the animal it can pave the way for the emergence of monstrosity. In Chapter 2 of the book, we shall delve deep into the analysis of horror as illustrated in the novels and video games of the Dead Space series. Here, through a multi-theoretical perspective, we shall find how horrors and monstrosity can manifest themselves in both written as well as digital, virtual media. In Chapter 3, we shall delve into the discussion of the power of simulation in the construction of an immersive and hyperreal post- /transhuman culture where the distinction between real and virtual and material and immaterial vanishes altogether. In Chapter 4 we dedicate the entire chapter to the study of Kim Stanley Robinson’s systems novel The Ministry for the Future (2020) to attempt a critique of the elements of good and bad Anthropocene. Though not directly and intimately related to the study of posthumanism and transhumanism, yet a discussion of the elements of the Anthropocene will be of immense contemporary relevance to us. The next Chapter, i.e., Chapter 5 will attempt to present an explication of the role of machines in the realization of posthuman culture. Chapter 6 is primarily concerned with an analysis of Stephen Baxter’s novels to see how posthuman culture is constructed around the agency of the autopoietic machines. The final chapter attempts to present a brief analysis of three of Iain M Banks’ Culture novels, namely Matter, Surface Detail, and Hydrogen Sonata to elaborate on the employment of posthuman/transhuman tropes in these works.

title: Writing Sci-Fi, Fantasy, & Horror For Dummies
author: Rick Dakan, Ryan G. Van Cleave
description: Take your shot at becoming the next Tolkien, Asimov, or King with this simple roadmap to transforming your fiction into works of art Writing Sci-Fi, Fantasy, & Horror For Dummies is your skeleton key to creating the kind of fiction that grips readers and compels them to keep turning pages (even if it's well past their bedtime!) You'll start with the basics of creative writing—including character, plot, and scene—and strategies for creating engaging stories in different forms, such as novels, short stories, scripts, and video games. After that, get beginner-friendly and straightforward advice on worldbuilding, before diving headfirst into genre-specific guidance for science fiction, horror, and fantasy writing. This book also offers: Strategies for editing and revising your next work to get it into tip-top shape for your audience Ways to seek out second opinions from editors, experts, and even sensitivity readers Techniques for marketing and publication, working with agents, and advice for writers going the self-publishing route The perfect beginner's guide for aspiring writers with an interest in horror, fantasy, or science fiction, Writing Sci-Fi, Fantasy, & Horror For Dummies is the first and last resource you need before you start building your next story about faraway lands, aliens, and fantastic adventures.

title: MEJORES CUENTOS DE HP LOVECRAFT
author: H.P. Lovecraft
description: El escritor estadounidense Howard Phillips Lovecraft (1890-1937), más conocido como H.P. Lovecraft, es una figura icónica en la literatura de terror y ciencia ficción, ampliamente considerado como uno de los maestros del género. Sus obras a menudo exploran temas como el miedo a lo desconocido y la insignificancia de la humanidad frente al cosmos. Su estilo de escritura se caracteriza por una prosa densa, erudita y atmosférica, que contribuye a la sensación de terror en sus historias. En este libro electrónico, al igual que en otras ediciones de la Colección Mejores Cuentos, conocerás una parte representativa de la vasta obra de H.P. Lovecraft. Son algunos sus mejores cuentos, algunos de los cuales son ampliamente conocidos entre los lectores del género, como "La llamada de Cthulhu", "La cosa en el umbral", "El testimonio de Randolph Carter", "Dagon", "La historia del Necronomicón" y otros que te dejarán sin aliento. Si eres fanático del género de Terror Fantástico, definitivamente, H.P. Lovecraft es el autor que debes leer.

title: El castigo
author: Guillem Sala
description: Una novela vibrante, llena de vida, de sexo y de caos, protagonizada por dos personajes inolvidables. Sandra llega tarde a clase. Y no es la primera vez, pero es una buena profesora, nadie en su instituto del barrio barcelonés de Sant Andreu puede negarlo. Hace dos años que sale con Albert, un escritor que, a su vez, fue su profesor en la universidad, aunque en ocasiones duda de lo que verdaderamente siente por él. Entre una clase y otra, en la pausa para el café a media mañana, Sandra empieza a fijarse en un compañero recién llegado al instituto, un joven llamado Minu. Sandra también es tutora de un alumno, Izan, que está a punto de meterse en problemas y pronto necesitará su ayuda. Pero ella arrastra desde su infancia una relación turbulenta con su hermana y su madre, y, aunque nadie lo sepa, hace mucho tiempo que está en guerra consigo misma. Para tratar de enderezar el rumbo, Sandra evocará a la niña que fue, antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

title: The Girl Who Grew Wings: a stunning YA fantasy romance inspired by Greek mythology
author: Anna  Waterworth
description: A stunning YA romantasy inspired by Greek mythology by the acclaimed author of The Fandom duology. Twin sisters, Icari and Sephie, live in a world where magical gifts are bestowed on a chosen few, divided into three callings: healers, embalmers and alchemists. Icari is a born healer. Sephie is shocked when she’s told she’s an embalmer; especially since she already has alchemist powers. One person holding two powers is a crime punishable by death, so Sephie now carries a fatal secret. When winged demons steal Sephie to the underworld, only a pair of wings can bring Icari to save her twin. But can a gentle healer learn to fight – and fly? A thrilling YA fantasy adventure romance inspired by Greek mythology From the acclaimed author of The Fandom duology, Anna Day A tale of love, sisterhood, magic and the triumph of life and truth over death Set in a gorgeous desert world of Oases and citadels PRAISE FOR THE FANDOM: 'I couldn't put it down' MELINDA SALISBURY 'I cannot recommend The Fandom highly enough' LOUISE O'NEILL 'I devoured The Fandom in one sitting' KIRAN MILLWOOD HARGRAVE '[A] glorious epic ode to fan culture ... For fans of Fangirl and Caraval.' BUZZFEED

title: The Beginner's Guide to Alchemy
author: Sarah Durn
description: Transform Your Mind and Soul to Find Your Highest Self There's a lot more to alchemy than turning lead into gold. Alchemists are committed to not only the transformation of actual substances with elements but also the transformation of themselves. This beginner's guide teaches you how to refine the baser parts of yourself (such as your fears, doubts, and anger) and take steps to uncover your truest, enlightened self. Know Your History—Learn all about alchemy's roots and basic principles, including its three primary facets: physical, spiritual, and mental. Discover Who You Are—Insightful activities and introspective journaling exercises make alchemy accessible. Expand Your Learning—Explore illustrated vignettes on notable alchemists, like Nicolas Flamel and Christina of Sweden, along with charts on the Ladder of the Planets and their corresponding elemental associations. Bring positive change into your life with the transformative powers of alchemy in this beginner's guide.

title: The Ultimate Encyclopedia of Fantasy
author: David Pringle, Tim Dedpulos
description: This essential reference book details everything the novice needs to know about the genre and everything the well-read fan is calling out for. Lavishly illustrated and expertly informed, it is edited by Tim Dedopulos and David Pringle, editor and co-founder of the internationally acclaimed Interzone magazine, and features forewords by legendary authors Terry Pratchett and Ben Aaronovitch. They have assembled a team of expert contributors to compile a visually stunning, informative and fascinating guide to the world of fantasy, from its origins and early trailblazers to the cultural phenomena of today's mega fantasy properties.

title: The Alchemy of Stones
author: Robert Simmons
description: • 2021 Coalition of Visionary Resources Gold Award • Reveals that those who love and work with crystals and stones have been intuitively following the path of spiritual alchemy • Provides meditative practices with specific stones to go with each stage of the alchemical transformation process as well as other tools and techniques • Includes an illustrated dictionary summarizing the spiritual qualities of more than 375 different minerals, crystals, and gemstones The Alchemy of Stones presents an inspired breakthrough in Robert Simmons’ thirty-five year career of exploring and revealing the spiritual qualities and potentials of minerals, crystals, and gemstones. This holistic, Earth-based framework for understanding stones and their energies initiates readers into an alchemical worldview that leads to spiritual healing, transformation, and transcendence. Engaging readers step by step, Simmons provides guidance on discovering and harnessing the three human powers of intention, attention, and imagination, each a crucial component for meeting and working in harmony with the energies of the Stone Beings. Simmons also introduces us to the Divine Feminine intelligence known as Sophia, or Wisdom. The Stone Beings are her emissaries, and through relating and co-creating with them, the healing and redemption of ourselves and the Earth becomes a reality. Offering an illustrated dictionary of the spiritual qualities of more than 375 different minerals, crystals, and gemstones, Simmons also explores in depth what he calls the Four Cornerstones of the Alchemy of Stones: Moldavite, Phenacite, Azeztulite, and Rosophia. He discusses the stages of alchemical transformation and provides meditative practices with specific stones to go with each stage. He also explores how to work with stone mandalas, crystal body layouts, gemstone elixirs, and Orgonite energy devices and details powerful techniques for working with stones. Woven throughout are Simmons’ personal stories of the pivotal mystical experiences that triggered his capacity to feel stone energies and led him to develop his relationship with the stones, revealing how this work can open minds and awaken hearts. Lavishly illustrated, The Alchemy of Stones is an invitation to a journey of enlightenment, transformation, and spiritual metamorphosis aligned with the path of our living, conscious Earth.

title: Grow
author: Karl Beckstrand
description: A biracial child and grandfather till, plant, and harvest fruits, vegetables, flowers, and grains in a tongue-twisting picture book with online tips for starting your own garden. Selected by The Library of Congress, The USDA (Virginia Tech), Oregon Agriculture in the Classroom Foundation, and The Georgia Farm Bureau. Children love to see how food grows. Learn basic gardening and discover animals—revealed in online SECRETS. Build kids’ minds today! Discover six Food Books for Kids (series) in a bundle—plus free ebooks, recipes, and lesson plans: Bad Bananas: A Story Cookbook for Kids The Dancing Flamingos of Lake Chimichanga Crumbs on the Stairs – Migas en las escaleras: A Mystery in English & Spanish She Doesn’t Want the Worms: A Mystery Ma MacDonald Flees the Farm Bedtime peace. The perfect length book for young kids (not too long for adults): 28 pages, 8.5′′x8.5′′ hard/soft cover ecology/environment children’s book. KidsWorldBooks (worldwide rights © Oct. 2020) and sustainable book distributors. How does your garden grow? 325 dyslexic-friendly words by best-selling author and college media instructor Karl Beckstrand (don’t miss his 60 multiracial books). Illustrated by Zanara for ages 4 – 7, Pre-K – 2nd grade. "Rollicking fun...cleverly written...multicultural illustrations in brilliant colors.... [A] wealth of information." - Barbara Mojica, Top 1,000 Reviewer LOOK inside! School/homeschool ESL/ELL/ESOL. No AI, CRT, gender, or orientation discussions—just happy growing fun! JNF022000, JUV050000, GAR000000, JUV011010, JUV006000, JUV020000, JUV029000, JUV054000; YNPG, YNPC, YFP; LCCN: 2020945698; Hard ISBN: 978-1951599072, soft: 978-1951599089, (eISBN: 978-1951599447)

title: Early Modern Women Writers Engendering Descent
author: Marie H. Loughlin
description: Focusing on Mary Sidney Herbert and Mary Sidney Wroth’s use of the figures of origin, descent, and inheritance in their poetry and prose, this book examines how these central women writers situated themselves in terms of early modern England’s rich ancestral cultures, employing these and other genealogical concepts to talk about authorship, family, selfhood, and memory. In turn, both Sidney Herbert and Sidney Wroth also shaped their works in relation to the ways in which writers within their familial communities and literary coteries constructed them as Sidneys, heirs, descendants, and future ancestors, in genres ranging from the patronage dedication and pastoral eclogue to mythographic genealogia and georgic poetry. In the intersection of ancestry, death, sexuality, and reproduction, the book contends that Sidney Herbert and Sidney Wroth develop their authorship within the simultaneous rigidity and flexibility of their world’s genealogical discourses.

title: Skeleton Knight in Another World (Manga) Vol. 14
author: Ennki Hakari
description: Reborn as a heroic...skeleton?! The manga adaptation of the isekai fantasy light novel series that also inspired an anime! One day Arc wakes up in the world of his favorite MMORPG...and discovers that he's become exactly like his game character, a heroic knight who just so happens to be a skeleton! The whole skull-for-a-head thing is maybe going to be a problem. Arc resolves to keep a low profile, lest anyone mistake him for a monster, but he can't quite manage to turn a blind eye to the troubles of his new world. Adventure awaits, and the Skeleton Knight will be there to meet it!

title: Into the Deepest, Most Unknowable Dungeon Vol. 10
author: KAKERU
description: As Jean's party delves into the lower dungeons to explore unknown territory, the recently resurrected White Mask Blond Hair takes aim at a new goal--capturing the fortified base in the Forest of Death! But Jean and the girls are traveling a route that brings them in sight of the very same base! Will they encounter their own deaths?! No magic! No magic! No cheats! Delve deep, balls deep, into this isekai adventure!

title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill: Sui’s Great Adventure: Volume 6
author: Ren Eguchi
description: Mukohda and co. are finally leaving Karelina. After a few tearful farewells and an exchange of gifts, they’re off to the next town, Krehl! However, getting there comes with its own share of trouble, as it turns out that sprinting around on wolfback is not exactly the most secure way to travel! Plus, after they reach the next town, Mukohda gets no time to sightsee or shop. Instead, he somehow finds himself sent straight back out on a mission to a dim forest filled with giant bugs! And big creepy crawlies aren’t the only things lurking in the dense woodlands, as a long-awaited encounter is also right around the corner!

title: Arcadia -The Lord of Death-
author: Fictitious
description: A Gamelit Dark Fantasy Isekai Adventure. Once a fallen angel of Heaven, now a worker drone at a dead-end job, Gabriel skipped work for the first time to log into his favorite MMORPG Arcadia Online for the last time. Everything was not as it first seemed though, as he and some of his guild members quickly found themselves stuck in a fantasy world with no way back to their own. As a max-level Death Knight Lord, with powerful divine equipment, and as one of the strongest players in Arcadia Online's competitive PvP scene, Gabriel might as well be a God compared to normal beings. But... nothing ever goes exactly as planned, especially in a kill or be killed world.

title: Let's Buy the Land and Cultivate It in a Different World (Manga) Vol. 4
author: Rokujuuyon Okazawa
description: In this fantasy isekai story, a salaryman sent to another world chooses a farming life over adventure--and ends up with a mermaid wife! Norio, a corporate drone in modern Japan, is summoned to a fantasy world to fight evil! But it turns out that the magical ability he got doesn’t work?! Thankfully, he has a plan B. Ask for a plot of land to cultivate a farm! To his surprise, that supposedly useless magic ability turbo charges his tools, allowing him to craft with wood like a master and plant vast fields of crops. After fishing up a mermaid wife, charming a lich, and tempting a young dragon over to his side with home cooking, there’s nothing our hero can’t do!

title: Housekeeping Mage from Another World: Making Your Adventures Feel Like Home! Volume 1
author: You Fuguruma
description: Shiori is an average Japanese office worker who was suddenly teleported to another world. Four years later, she’s managed to carve out a niche for herself—as a housekeeping mage. Alec is an A-class adventurer, just returned from a long-term assignment. When his friend Zack, the local Guild Master, tempts him into going on a manticore hunt by promising to bring in a mage with special skills, what Alec finds is the last thing he could have expected. On the outside, the two couldn’t be more different. Yet deep in their hearts, they each yearn for the same thing: a place to belong. In the face of old wounds, their dark pasts, and the everyday challenges any adventurer must overcome, will they find the courage to risk being hurt again?

title: No Longer Allowed in Another World Vol. 4
author: Hiroshi Noda

title: CALL TO ADVENTURE! Defeating Dungeons with a Skill Board (Manga) Vol. 5
author: Aki Hagiu
description: HARUKI TO THE RESCUE! Haruki has teamed up with a party of intermediate adventurers! Their mission? Defeat the monster swarm’s boss! That’s easier said than done, however, and the adventurers soon find themselves facing a far more difficult fight than expected! Can Haruki turn the tide by putting his life on the line and activating a new skill?

title: DUNGEON DIVE: Aim for the Deepest Level (Manga) Vol. 1
author: Tarisa Warinai, Keisuke Sato
description: When Aikawa Kanami is suddenly transported to another dimension, he's thrust into a world of magic and monsters. In this strange land, adventurers band together to try and clear the Dungeon, a mysterious labyrinth with a hundred levels. Legend says that if you reach the hundredth level, any wish you have will be granted. All Kanami wants is to get back home to his ill little sister, but does a level 1 newb like him even stand a chance?

title: Might as Well Cheat: I Got Transported to Another World Where I Can Live My Wildest Dreams! (Manga) Vol. 1
author: Munmun
description: An isekai tale about a man reborn into a new world to live out a sexy fantasy! When thirty-year-old office drone Satou Tarou dies in an accident, a god intervenes and transports him to another world. After being granted two cheat powers—maxed-out healing and potion-making magic—Satou Tarou changes his name to Tauro, and begins his new life in this fantastical parallel world. Adventure? World Domination? No, no, he’s not going to do anything dangerous like that. Not when there are brothels to visit!

title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill: Volume 1 (Manga)
author: Akagishi K, Ren Eguchi, Kevin Chen
description: When Mukohda Tsuyoshi is summoned to a world of swordplay and sorcery, he's pumped to go on the adventure of a lifetime! Just one problem: he's summoned by mistake!Not only is he not one of the three heroes, his stats are also laughable. Looks like he'll be averagely average in this world too...but given that the people of the kingdom seem the type to take advantage of their heroes, Mukohda's determined to make his own way in this new world.Mukohda aims to lead a comfortable life with the help of his unique skill, "Online Supermarket"! But when he introduces the taste of modern cooking to the fantasy world, Tsuyoshi winds up with repeat customers who just can't get enough!

title: She's the Strongest Bride, But I'm Stronger in Night Battles: A Harem Chronicle of Advancing Through Cunning Tactics (Manga) Vol. 3
author: Singyougaku
description: THE SEXY ISEKAI ADVENTURE CONTINUES! The reincarnated Albert is happily married to the sexy, bloodthirsty Blood Demon Lady Marida. He's the brains behind her brawn, using his tactical expertise from his former life to grow his wife's power and her harem of gorgeous women (which she loves to share)! Will Albert's scheming put him on the wrong side of Lady Marida's father, the Demon Lord? It's the third act of this naughty harem romp!

title: CALL to ADVENTURE! Defeating Dungeons with a Skill Board (Manga) Vol. 6
author: Aki Hagiu

title: The Otherworlder, Exploring the Dungeon, Vol. 2 (manga)
author: Hinagi Asami
description: Souya’s dungeon adventure has begun in earnest, but now that he has cast aside his guns, he’ll need to master a new weapon if he wants to hold his own. The bow seems like a promising choice, especially after he convinces a pair of beautiful elven sisters to teach him. Things are going smoothly—until the elves’ mysterious past catches up with them! What once looked like a quick side quest ends with Souya embroiled in royal politics and fighting for the honor of his new comrades...!!

title: My Isekai Life
author: Shinkoshoto
genres: Fantasy comic books, strips, etc - isekai adventure

title: DUNGEON DIVE: Aim for the Deepest Level (Manga) Vol. 4
author: Tarisa Warinai
description: A compelling isekai fantasy adventure based on the light novels in Japan! One moment Kanami is visiting his sick little sister in the hospital, and the next thing he knows, he wakes up in a dark corridor full of cutthroat warriors and bloodthirsty monsters. Kanami quickly learns that he is in the "labyrinth," a deadly 100-floor dungeon in a fantasy world--and for those able to reach the deepest level, a wish will be granted. Kanami seems to have received magic powers and a special unnamed skill that kicks in whenever he is overwhelmed, which helps him stabilize but has a disturbing effect on his emotions and mind. After attracting the attention of a mysterious girl, Kanami may have the power he needs to return home to his ailing sister...but at what price?

title: Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World (Manga) Vol. 6
author: Yashu
description: A story about a modern man who finds himself reincarnated as a young nobleman with powerful magic! After dying in the act of stopping a crime in modern Japan, our hero is reincarnated as Cain von Silford, third son of a noble family in a world of swords and sorcery. In his new life, all children receive a blessing from the gods…but Cain is unexpectedly blessed with an absolutely enormous, over-the-top cornucopia of magical powers. If his dream of traveling the world as a free spirit is to come true, he can’t reveal too much of his potential to the wrong people. A light-hearted, escapist adventure in another world begins!

title: El Maestro Guerrero Es Un Soso, Pero Es El Mas Fuerte 1
author: Rokurou Akashi
description: A Japanese student named Shirokuro Sansui died because of God's mistake and was teleported to a different world. He claimed that he wishes to become the Strongest, so he received a referral letter for a Sage from God and received 500 years of training. When he reached a stage where he could be called the Strongest in the common people's standard, he picked up a baby near his training grounds, and there, he finally starts his isekai adventure. His training is simple, his techniques are simple, he's 'the Strongest' but he looks simple. With an ordinary wooden sword in hand, the fight of the simple-looking Sword Saint has just begun.

title: Rise of a Manor Lord 2
author: T E Bakutis
description: Drake has secured his manor and his people's loyalty. Now, it's time to go on offense. Confronted with a mandatory summons from the capital city, Drake reluctantly takes his new manor on the road. Now protected by his loyal battle maids, his fierce zarovian soldiers, and his powerful new rarity, he'll face evil assassins, clueless bounty hunters, and ruthless mercenaries on his way to a council with manor lords who hope to remove him from power. Yet with the help of his loyal steward, his savvy butler, and a surprisingly bloodthirsty fellow manor lord, Drake will challenge those who seek to unseat him with rumor and doublespeak. Through careful negotiation, well-placed deceptions, and sheer unmitigated chutzpah, Drake must strip away the layers of the conspiracy that threatens him and secure his role as a manor lord no other will challenge... and a ruler even the powerful noble court must respect. The second volume of a humorous, adventure-packed Progression Fantasy featuring cat girls, battle maids, political machinations, and a habit of setting the worst Isekai tropes on fire and tossing them in the garbage.

title: Shangri-La Frontier 17
author: RYOSUKE. FUJI, Katarina
description: A fast-paced, irreverent adventure for fans of isekai and RPGs! High schooler Rakuro loves hunting down "trash games," but one day he decides to play a AAA VR game called Shangri-La Frontier instead. He creates a character with a bird head, skips the cutscenes and jumps right in--but what awaits him in this game is different from anything he's ever faced...

title: The Savior's Book Café Story in Another World (Manga) Vol. 2
author: Kyouka Izumi, Oumiya
description: A SPELLBINDING ADVENTURE! Since being transported to a new world Tsukina has made a cozy life for herself, doing magic and running a book café. She’s even grown closer to Il, a handsome soldier who also loves reading. But Tsukina is keeping a huge secret from him: she is a Savior, sent to this world to help protect it. By hiding away in her book café, is she neglecting her duties? And will Il hate her for it when he finds out?

title: Divine Invasion
author: Aaron Renfroe
description: The magical world of Volar is dying. To save themselves and their followers, the native gods have instituted a plan, one that will transform Earth mortals into anchors for their powers.Ty, and thousands of other humans are summoned through portals and given one mission: choose a god and power up as fast as they can. An Isekai/Portal/Progression series, the Divine Invasion is the first book in a fast-paced adventure story set in both our world and Volar. Expect demons, dragons, dungeons, and unexpected plot twists to take the story in new and strange directions at every turn. The gods gave him six months to prepare for their twisted games. What he does next will surprise them all.

title: Shangri-La Frontier 11
author: Ryosuke Fuji, Katarina
description: A fast-paced, irreverent adventure for fans of isekai and RPGs! High schooler Rakuro loves hunting down "trash games," but one day he decides to play a AAA VR game called Shangri-La Frontier instead. He creates a character with a bird head, skips the cutscenes and jumps right in--but what awaits him in this game is different from anything he's ever faced... PENCILGON'S PROPOSAL Having survived a fierce attack by one of the Shangri-La Frontier PK clans, Sunraku goes into the fighting ring against ten powerful monsters as part of a unique scenario. He barely escapes with his life, only to then receive an invitation from his gamer friend Pencilgon to help her take down a unique monster known as Wethermon the Tombguard. With Wethermon still undefeated by any of the game's 30 million players, Sunraku may have bitten off more than he can chew!

title: The Introvert's Guide to Dating
author: Courtney Geter LMFT, CST
description: Navigate the road to romance and enjoy dating as an introvert People often assume an outgoing personality is needed to succeed at dating. But being an introvert doesn't mean that a relationship is unattainable—you just have to learn how to use your unique strengths to your advantage. The Introvert's Guide to Dating shows you how.
